## Detailed Services

### 1. Amazon Account Management
- Complete seller central onboarding and brand registry assistance.
- A+ Content creation, storefront design, product listing optimization, bullet points, titles, and SEO keywords.
- Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display PPC campaign creation & optimization.
- Account health monitoring, IP claim resolution, stranded inventory fixes, and seller support ticket resolution.

### 2. Flipkart Account Management
- Seller hub onboarding, listing creation, and catalog upload.
- Flipkart PLA (Product Listing Ads) management and campaign ROI optimization.
- Smart fulfillment setup, account rating improvement, and pricing strategy.

### 3. Quick-Commerce Account Management (Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Zepto)
- Onboarding digital brands onto fast-delivery platforms (Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Zepto).
- Dark store inventory alignment, regional listing approval, and high-frequency campaign execution.

### 4. Search Engine Optimization (SEO) & Web Development
- Technical SEO, Local SEO (Google Business Profile optimization), and e-commerce keyword optimization.
- Custom modern React web development, high-converting landing pages, and web applications built with speed, mobile responsiveness, and SEO best practices.

### 5. Free Seller & SEO Utilities
- Free AI Product Listing Generator.
- Free SEO Keyword Research Tool.
- Free E-Commerce Profit Margin Calculator.
